risks: Supplier cost unknown: Moradabad listings at Rs 75-95/piece are implausible for solid ~550 g brass; a real quote may be far higher. Out-of-state supplier (UP) means website-only via bill-to-ship-to (docs/05), so cost must be about Rs 375 or less (~29% of Rs 1,299)
Meesho lists 8 in metal urli bowls at unseen prices; if they sell near Rs 300-500, Rs 1,299 will not hold. Check the live Meesho/Amazon.in price before asking for a quote
'Pure brass' / 'solid brass' is a material claim needing supplier evidence (policy require_evidence_for_claims); brass-plated iron or aluminium look-alikes are common
Close to already-explored brass metalware (brass puja thali, brass bells, singing bowls, kansa katori); reviewer to check it is not a repeat of a failed line
Dents and scratched polish in transit drive 'not as pictured' returns; tarnishes, needs a care card
Seasonal demand (Diwali/festive decor), so off-season sales may be low
Do not show lit candles/diyas inside as included; sell the bowl only (no flammables)
GST: brass decorative ware (HSN 7418/8306) assumed 12%, may differ after the GST rate changes of 22-09-2025; CA to confirm
